_note: Reviewed zh gloss fixes, read by tools/pack_from_hsk.py (via tools/zh_gloss.js); keyed by the pack headword `w`. en: replaces the hsk `en` (must still equal `was`, else the upstream gloss changed and the override is stale); src cites the wording (CC-CEDICT via complete-hsk-vocabulary complete.json, which has every sense untruncated; the hsk data keeps only the first two) and puts the HSK 1-4 core sense first. synonyms: word groups that are never each other's distractor (words[].syn); "typed": true also accepts each as a typed answer on the others' meaning stimulus (words[].typedSyn), only for truly interchangeable words. notTyped: reviewed [stimulus word, typed word] pairs the generated typedSyn rule proposed (or could propose) that stay wrong answers. noTypedMeaning: add / remove words against the generated rule. Report: docs/ZH_GLOSS.md.
